 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 show_error('2137');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_UNCHECKEDIN_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_uncheckedin_units IS
/* This program was modified by Edwin for the PR#001.031923. If reference is needed check the 2.03 version */

 temp_int varchar2(15);
 v_count number:=0;
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, coll_date
 from donations
 where coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and unit_id is not null
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 unit_id not in (
 Select b.unit_id from donations a, units b where
 a.coll_date = :donations.coll_date and
 a.unit_id is not null and
 a.unit_id=b.unit_id and 
 b.coll_date=:donations.coll_date and
 a.chapter_id is not null);
BEGIN
 go_block('uncheck_units');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :uncheck_units.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :uncheck_units.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 v_count := v_count + 1;
 if v_count >= :donations.uc_count then
 exit;
 end if;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 end loop;
 FIRST_RECORD;
go_block('donations');
 --go_item('donations.coll_date');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_UNREGISTERED_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_unregistered_units IS
 temp_int varchar2(15);
 v_count number:=0;
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id,coll_date,bag_code
 from units
 where coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and unit_id is not null and contract_id='INTERNAL'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 unit_id not in (
 Select b.unit_id from donations a, units b where
 a.coll_date = :donations.coll_date and
 a.unit_id is not null and
 a.unit_id=b.unit_id and 
 b.coll_date=:donations.coll_date and 
 a.chapter_id is not null); 
BEGIN
 go_block('unreg_units');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :unreg_units.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :unreg_units.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :unreg_units.bag_code := c1_rec.bag_code;
 v_count := v_count + 1;
 if v_count = :donations.count then
 exit;
 end if;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 end loop;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 go_block('donations');
 --go_item('donations.coll_date');
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_count IS
temp_int varchar2(15);
 v_count number:=0;
 v_units number:=0;
 v_both number:=0;
 v_don number:=0;
 v_uncheck number:=0;
 v_unregis number:=0;
 
BEGIN

 select count(unit_id) into v_don
 from donations
 where coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and unit_id is not null
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;


 select count(*) into v_both
 from donations a, units b
 where a.coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and a.unit_id is not null and
 b.unit_id=a.unit_id
 and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 

 select count(unit_id) into v_units
 from units
 where coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and contract_id='INTERNAL' 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 
 
 select count(*) into v_uncheck
 from donations
 where coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and unit_id is not null
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 unit_id not in (
 Select b.unit_id from donations a, units b where
 a.coll_date = :donations.coll_date and
 a.unit_id is not null and
 a.unit_id=b.unit_id and 
 b.coll_date=:donations.coll_date and
 a.chapter_id is not null);
 
 
 select count(*) into v_unregis
 from units
 where coll_date = :donations.coll_date
 and unit_id is not null and contract_id='INTERNAL'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 unit_id not in (
 Select b.unit_id from donations a, units b where
 a.coll_date = :donations.coll_date and
 a.unit_id is not null and
 a.unit_id=b.unit_id and 
 b.coll_date=:donations.coll_date and 
 a.chapter_id is not null); 
 
 
 :donations.uc_count:=v_uncheck; --uncheked in units
 If :donations.uc_count < 0 then 
 :donations.uc_count:=0;
 End If;
 
 :donations.count:=v_unregis; --units - v_both; --uncheked in units
 If :donations.count < 0 then 
 :donations.count:=0;
 End If;

--message('v-don='||v_don||' v-both='||v_both||' v-units='||v_units);pause;

/* Unchecked Units */

/*

if v_don = v_both then
 :donations.uc_count := 0;
elsif v_don > v_both then
 :donations.uc_count := v_don - v_both;
elsif v_both > v_don then
 :donations.count := v_both-v_don;
 :donations.uc_count := 0;
end if;

message('v-don='||v_don||' v-both='||v_both||' v-units='||v_units);pause;

/* Unregistered Units */

/*
if v_units = v_both then
 :donations.count := 0;
elsif v_units > v_both then
 :donations.count := v_units - v_both;
elsif v_both > v_units then
 :donations.uc_count := v_both-v_units;
 :donations.count := 0;
end if;
*/ 

END;
